banner.text: Not legal advice: Chukti AI helps organize contract text and review preferences. Have a qualified lawyer review important terms before signing.

documentPane.title: Contract PDF
documentPane.emptyDescription: Drag and drop a PDF here, or choose a file from your device. Up to 10 MB and 80 pages.
documentPane.rulesNote: Text-based PDFs only. Scanned or image-only PDFs without a text layer are not supported.
documentPane.processingServer: Reading PDF pages and normalizing text...
documentPane.emptyPageText: No readable text on this page.

errorCodes.not_pdf: Invalid file format. Please upload a valid PDF file starting with %PDF-.
errorCodes.too_large: File exceeds 10 MB. Please upload a PDF of 10 MB or less.
errorCodes.too_many_pages: This PDF has more than 80 pages. Please upload a PDF with 80 pages or fewer.
errorCodes.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Please remove the password and upload an unlocked PDF.
errorCodes.corrupt: This PDF could not be parsed and may be corrupted.
errorCodes.scanned_unsupported: This PDF has no usable text layer. OCR is not supported in this version.
errorCodes.unknown: Could not process this upload. Please try again.

playbookPane.title: Your 5-Preference Playbook
playbookPane.starterNote: Starter defaults, not yet reviewed by a lawyer.
playbookPane.noDocumentNotice: Upload a contract PDF first to save a playbook for that document.
playbookPane.saveErrorSummary: Please fix the highlighted fields and try again.

liabilityCap.title: 1. Liability cap
liabilityCap.requireLabel: Require a cap on your financial liability
liabilityCap.requireHelp: Protects you from unlimited financial claims if a dispute happens.
liabilityCap.multipleLabel: Maximum cap (multiple of contract fees, 0.5 to 10)
liabilityCap.multipleHelp: Limits your total liability to this multiple of the fees you receive.

paymentTerms.title: 2. Payment terms
paymentTerms.maxDaysLabel: Maximum days to get paid (1 to 120)
paymentTerms.maxDaysHelp: Caps how long a client can wait after invoicing before payment is overdue.

ipOwnership.title: 3. IP ownership
ipOwnership.selectLabel: When work ownership transfers to the client
ipOwnership.selectHelp: Prevents losing ownership rights before your invoice is paid in full.

termination.title: 4. Termination
termination.noticeHelp: Gives you advance notice before a client can end active work.
termination.payWorkDoneLabel: Require payment for work already done
termination.payWorkDoneHelp: Ensures completed milestones or hours are paid even if cancelled early.

scopeChanges.title: 5. Scope changes
scopeChanges.writtenOrderHelp: Stops unpaid extra work by requiring written approval before scope expands.
